parameters.help_en:
The ID of the instance in reserved storage mode.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/86911.html operation to query the information about all AnalyticDB for PostgreSQL instances within a region, including instance IDs

存储预留模式实例ID。

parameters.help_en:
The name of the collection.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2401497.html operation to create a vector collection and call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2401503.html operation to query a list of vector collections

集合名。

parameters.help_en:
The type of the permissions that you want to grant. Valid values:

rw: the read and write permissions.
ro: the read-only permission.
none: the delete permission
parameters.help_zh:
授权类型，可选值：

ro：只读权限
none：删除权限

parameters.help_en:
The name of the manager account that has the rds_superuser permission.
